name: Amirmahdi Namjoo
lead: I work on computer architecture, systems, and high-performance computing, with a focus on efficient hardware accelerators for sparse and scientific workloads.
about: I am a Ph.D. student in Computer Science at the **University of Maryland**, where I research computer architecture and systems in Bahar Asgari's group. My work centers on hardware acceleration for sparse linear algebra, memory systems, and efficient high-performance computing. I completed my B.Sc. in Computer Engineering at **Sharif University of Technology**, where I was a teaching assistant for more than fifteen courses and active in the student scientific community.
